result.evidence: In src/api/reports.ts, duplicating a report uses `truncate(`${source.name} (copy)`, MAX_NAME_LENGTH)`. When `source.name` is close to the 120-character limit, appending ` (copy)` exceeds MAX_NAME_LENGTH (120), so `truncate` cuts it off and appends `...`, replacing ` (copy)` entirely with `...`. To fix this, `source.name` should be truncated or sliced to fit `MAX_NAME_LENGTH - " (copy)".length` (or similar) before appending ` (copy)`.
